key_insight: Training language models on structured experimental evidence helped guide perovskite solar-cell design, selecting a contact that delivered 27.05% power conversion efficiency.
engineering_relevance: Evidence-grounded AI could help engineers choose materials and design discriminating experiments for more efficient, thermally stable perovskite devices.
method: Built PSM-Bench: 800 expert-developed questions on perovskite photovoltaics.
Adapted OpenPerov using evidence records from 4,035 articles linking experiments, controls, observations and mechanisms.
Used retrieved evidence to refine answers and experimentally tested an AI-selected self-assembled monolayer contact.
evidence_signal: OpenPerov Flash ranked first among 13 closed-book systems; the AI-selected K-analogue contact yielded devices with 27.05% efficiency and 96.74% retention after 1,000 hours of dark thermal ageing at 85°C.
watch_item: Dark thermal ageing does not establish operational lifetime under illumination; broader device validation remains necessary.
paper_title: Evidence-grounded large language models guide perovskite solar cell design and optimization
